def norm_phone(v):
    if v is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return str(v)
    if isinstance(v, int):
        return str(v)
    if isinstance(v, float) and v.is_integer():
        return str(int(v))
    s = str(v)
    if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.0", s):
        return s[:-2]
    return s

def norm_header(v):

    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(v).strip().lower())
